metadata.title: When Valorant Hands You 2 Kills and You’re Still Asking ‘Wait, What?’
metadata.description:
Wait, who gave me those kills?
Enemy must’ve been auditioning for AFK.
Valorant logic broke but I’m not complaining.
Click if your aim’s more ‘oops’ than ‘pro’!

Hit that follow if your best kills are total accidents!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
